scope: ADR-backed gated pilot policy for external API providers without enabling real calls by default

no_go_gates.condition: Any external API provider is enabled in versioned defaults.
Any test depends on OpenAI, Gemini or another real external API.
Any API key or secret value is versioned instead of an environment variable name.
Any future real external API path bypasses CostGuard or budget evidence.
Any future real external API path lacks a visible operator warning and risk report.

warnings: External API providers are optional and must never be required for production-ready-local operation.
A future real-call pilot must use local non-versioned config, environment variables, CostGuard and explicit operator acknowledgement.
POST-H-032-C does not implement vendor SDK calls, network transport or real prompt submission.
notes: POST-H-032-C creates an ADR and fake/gated pilot only; no real external API calls are enabled.
External providers remain disabled by default in source-controlled provider metadata.
Any future real call requires local opt-in, env-var secret handling, visible warning, CostGuard and a risk report.
limitations: This sprint does not implement vendor SDK calls or network transport.
The fake provider validates contracts only; it is not a quality signal for vendor responses.
External API usage must not become a production-ready-local requirement.
